subtitle: Mobile Power Guard — Cool Sonic Theater
changes: Introduced Mobile Power Guard inside the existing unified Sonic Theater; defaults to a conservative 24 FPS 640×360 efficient rendering profile on iPhone/iPad while preserving existing PC presets
Added user-selectable Cool & Save (15 FPS, 480×270 with animated backgrounds paused), Music Only (stop visual rendering without interrupting local music playback), and Smooth (30 FPS, 640×360) modes
Auto-pauses the global site ambient/thumbnail video when performing mobile Reactor rendering, with non-destructive playback restoration when returning to other studios

Pauses Reactor canvas drawing when the stage is offscreen or the page is hidden, and stops painting the collapsed 900×300 Media Theater advanced visualizer while continuing lightweight real-audio FFT updates
Adaptive profile detects low achieved frame rate and downshifts to a lighter workload; these signals reflect rendering performance, not hardware temperature or battery-health readings

Keeps custom Reactor worlds, previous Reactor IV effects, background media, saved music, Play on Start, mobile playlist controls, Web Audio and user presets untouched in their existing storage locations
Temporarily restores existing full-resolution drawing during user-requested PNG, animated GIF and silent video exports, then returns to the selected energy-saving live profile
Preserves PC visual quality by default, existing adaptive navigation, GitHub Pages, automated release validation, rolling rollback and direct Discord announcements
